void_v0.doc: Instance: the only address allowed to commit.
void_v0.name: Admin

void_v0.doc: Instance: the token (SAC) address claims pay out in.
void_v0.name: Token

void_v0.doc: Instance: total stroops the root commits to.
void_v0.name: Total

void_v0.doc: Instance: number of entries in the committed list.
void_v0.name: Count

tuple_v0.doc: Persistent: one mark per claimed index.
tuple_v0.name: Claimed

function_v0.doc: Claim the entry at `index` for its committed `amount`,\nproven against the root. The claimant's own authorization is\nrequired; the tokens go to the claimant and nowhere else.
function_v0.name: claim

function_v0.doc: Public read: (committed?, root, total, count). The root is\nzeroed until the commit lands.
function_v0.name: state

function_v0.doc:
Commit a whole distribution in one call. Admin auth only.
One-shot: a second commit is refused, so the root a stranger
checks can never be quietly replaced. The named total must
be covered by the token balance already held.
function_v0.name: commit

function_v0.doc: Public read: whether the entry at `index` has been claimed.
function_v0.name: claimed
